name: @metorial/ayrshare
description: Publish, schedule, and manage social media posts across 13 networks through Ayrshare. Check post history and publication status, retry failed posts, retrieve post and account analytics, retrieve, post, and delete comments, send and retrieve direct messages on Facebook, Instagram, and X/Twitter, and read reviews from Facebook Pages and Google Business Profile. Upload and host media, generate hashtags, shorten post links, and validate content before publishing. Manage user profiles and RSS feed subscriptions, and discover the current profile and its linked social accounts.
